This refinement can be applied at a category or brand level only. \| \| `ASIN_AGE_RANGE_SAME_AS` \| Target an age range that is in the expressed range. This refinement can be applied for toys and games categories only. \| \| `ASIN_GENRE_SAME_AS` \| Target products related to the expressed genre. This refinement can be applied for Books and eBooks categories only. \| \| `ASIN_EXPANDED_FROM` \| Target products similar in performance to the ASIN expressed. \| \| `KEYWORD_GROUP_SAME_AS` \| Target the keyword group that is the same as the keyword group expressed (Beta coming soon). \| \| `OTHER` \| Other Type. \| |
